'''Thakba Besadii Diori''' was a minor [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] criminal kingpin of the [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. Thakba dealt in [[Spice/Legends|spice]] and operated from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]], where he resided in a [[Thakba Besadii Diori's mansion|mansion]] in the company of his [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]] and a group of of [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] guards. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], after the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Bandin Dobah]] began exerting control over the flow of contraband into and out of [[Formos/Legends|Formos]], a planet situated near to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], the Hutts did not take kindly to Dobah's activities and Thakba placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] of 5,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] for his capture. Thakba issued the bounty primarily as a public relations exercise, hoping to improve his reputation within the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] community.

{{RPG|"[[Trouble Brewing]]"}}
A group of individuals succeeded at capturing Dobah and they subsequently turned the pirate over the Thakba on Sleheyron. The Hutt forced Dobah to fight in a [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] contest held within a nearby arena and he watched on as Dobah was [[Death/Legends|killed]] during his second bout, in combat against a [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]].
{{Endgame}}
